actions.reason: C0001 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity with large effect sizes in immune/inflammatory and metabolic pathways (|SMD|>1, q<0.05), supported by CNV continuous changes (chr20q gain, CDKN2A loss) and a significant BAP1 mutation enrichment. Measured technical confounders show no significant association, and known-label overlap with stage/grade is negligible. Cross-modal consistency is weak but does not actively contradict the RNA signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0001 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.

C0002 has a coherent RNA-defined biological identity opposite to C0001, with large effect sizes in metabolic upregulation and immune downregulation (|SMD|>1, q<0.05), supported by CNV continuous changes (lower chr20q, higher CDKN2A) and significant BAP1 mutation depletion. Measured technical confounders show no significant association, and known-label overlap with stage/grade is negligible. Cross-modal consistency is weak but does not actively contradict the RNA signal, and structural evidence does not positively support Split or Merge. Retaining C0002 as a discovery-stage candidate is better supported than Drop.
